column2: [intro]
In the shadow of computing, a riddle persists,
A thought that moves, a melancholy that resists.
An escape from a purely digital reality,
A vague sadness, an enigmatic emotion.
The Riddle of Computing, a veiled sadness,
A thought that escapes, into the abandoned horizon.
Between truth and illusion, a border escapes,
Another elusive force, that traps our lives.
We wander in circuits, lost in the abyss,
Doubts invade, a sadness that persists.
We seek answers, a meaning that eludes,
Melancholic computing, a riddle that corrodes.
The Riddle of Computing, a veiled sadness,
A thought that escapes, into the abandoned horizon.
Between truth and illusion, a border escapes,
Another elusive force, that traps our lives.
[ solo ]
The pixels reflect our invisible tears,
Computing whispers indescribable memories.
A sad symphony, in the silent cables,
The riddle of computing, a melancholy with no way out.
[outro]
